answer: Most recent Algebraic Topology paper on ArXiv (arXiv:2611.14105, newest announcement date group Wed, 11 Nov 2026): Title: Thom Morphisms, Self-Intersection, and the Sectional Category of a Section. Authors: Paul-Eugène Parent. Abstract: For sections between simply connected spaces of finite rational type, we compare module sectional category, sectional category and relative category after rationalization. Fibre Poincaré duality turns the compatibility of derived evaluation with the section into a derived self-intersection formula. We prove equality of the three invariants under any of four hypotheses: a base-dimension bound, finite total rational homotopy of the fibre, a smooth section with closed manifold fibre, or a compatible relative Frobenius model. Projective bundles over CP^k with fibre CP^r have common value k + r, which is unbounded even for fixed fibre. Whether fibre Poincaré duality alone suffices remains open.
